scope: Private C90 supplied-byte allocation bitmap descriptor and bounded bitmap interval observations. The original full0.1.0 platform/storage scope remains; no host IO, mount, allocator/writer, coherent directory traversal or present-source claim.
ownership: Extend the existing portable/exfat private API and add allocation.c; retain allocation cells in boot.c and checked/view primitives. No generic new scheduler or duplicate FAT owner.
descriptor: Exactly32borrowed bytes decode in-use81bitmap entry, identifier0/1, FirstCluster and DataLength. Caller supplies clusterCount1..2^32-11, cluster byte shift9..25 and FATcount1/2. Validate bitmap identifier fits FATcount, valid cluster2..clusterCount+1, length at least ceil(clusterCount/8) and at most checked heap bytes. Reserved bytes/bits remain raw with advisory issues. Descriptor validity does not establish root location/cardinality, chain correctness or active selection.
interval: Caller supplies at most8192borrowed bitmap bytes, their exact bitmap-relative u64byte offset, separately declared bitmap DataLength, clusterCount, first requested cluster and count, plus a requested-bit work budget. Refuse invalid API, oversized views, unavailable whole requested interval, offset+length overflow or exceeded budget without changing output/input. No proportional allocation. Checked interval must fit clusters2..clusterCount+1 and the declared bitmap length. Interpret bit(cluster-2) with lowbitfirst byte ordering; zero available_for_allocation, one unavailable, never assign ownership reason from bit alone. Report checked unavailable/available counts for exactly requested clusters; do not read beyond borrowed bytes or count reserved tail bits.
bindings: The algorithm observes supplied bitmap facts only. Runtime callers must bind the root descriptor, held source/capture/epoch, active mainFAT and corresponding bitmap identity. Stale backup flags, inactive copies, incomplete directory and root cardinality cannot authorize free-space, equality or mutation. No chain, bad-cluster cause or global filesystem health inferred.
acceptance: Independent Python byte/integer descriptor oracle for one/twoFAT identifiers, min/maxcluster counts, exact bitmap lengths, firstcluster, heap capacities and advisory reserved raw values.

Independent interval bit/count oracle across all byte bit positions, windows at large offsets/maxcluster, partial final bytes, zero/full/mixed patterns and exact requested boundary counts; exclude reserved bits.
Checked u64 offset/range overflow, invalid cluster/count/budget/truncated/overlong/inaccessible views preserve output/input; actual read-only/end-of-page protected guards.

StrictC90/native/header/import/source/artifact/context evidence and relevant exFAT/FAT/GPT regressions, with prior unchanged-source full results explicitly distinguished from fresh tests. No global allocation/owner/provider/writer/fullrelease admission.
later_gates: Root cardinality and source-bound active FAT/bitmap pairing with coherent paging before current free-space claims.
Validated upcase checksum/compressed mapping, full name comparison and hash verification before lookup/uniqueness.
Directory/FAT chain traversal and NoFatChain bitmap membership before data access; ValidDataLength zero filling before extraction.
Original multi-resource/production recovery/writer/privilege and all-platform release gates.
